Bash(gh pr create --title "refactor: unify focus and selection system" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

- Replaces dual `selectedTodoId` + `selectedTitleId` with unified `activeItemId` in store
- Adds `pendingFocusId` to store for managing focus requests (replaces focus-target.ts singleton)
- Arrow key navigation now updates both focus AND selection (sidebar stays in sync)
- Removes race conditions from focus-target singleton pattern

## Changes

- **Store**: New unified selection/focus state with `activeItemId` and `pendingFocusId`
- **New hooks**: `useActiveItem()` returns `{ todo, title }`
- **Deprecated**: `useSelectedTodo()` and `useSelectedTitle()` (still work via wrapper)
- **Deleted**: `lib/focus-target.ts` (no longer needed)
- **Updated**: TodoTextEditor, TaskItem, TodoSidebar, TodoKanbanView

## Test plan

- [ ] Create new task - should auto-focus and show in sidebar
- [ ] Navigate with arrow keys - sidebar should update to show focused task
- [ ] Click task - should select and show in sidebar
- [ ] Switch between kanban/list views - selection should persist
- [ ] Edit task details in sidebar - should save correctly

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)")
